name: CI
# Hosted runners check formatting, lints, tests, packaging and the WASM build only.
# AGENTS.md's performance targets are measured on real hardware (docs/DEVELOPMENT.md,
# Profiling), because shared virtual runners give neither stable timing nor a real
# display.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

# A newer push to the same branch or pull request supersedes the running checks.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    # bash on every runner: Windows' default pwsh does not stop multi-line
    # steps at the first failing native command.
    shell: bash
    working-directory: gpui-kit-material

jobs:
  check:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: gpui-kit-material
      # rust-toolchain.toml pins the exact compiler, components and targets.
      - name: Install the pinned toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install
          rustc --version
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: gpui-kit-material -> target
      - name: Linux libraries
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libwayland-dev libvulkan-dev libx11-xcb-dev libxcb1-dev libfontconfig-dev libfreetype-dev
      - run: cargo fmt --all --check
      - run: cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo test --locked --workspace
      # `cargo test --workspace` above ran the library, Gallery and benches on the default
      # Fast backend. The profiler changes only the Gallery and benches, so only they run
      # with it, and only the tests that need it: the rest are the 8 minutes just spent.
      - name: Check the upstream comparison backend
        run: |
          cargo clippy --locked -p gpui-kit-material --all-targets --no-default-features --features full,serde,embedded-symbols -- -D warnings
          cargo test --locked -p gpui-kit-material --no-default-features --features full,serde,embedded-symbols
          cargo clippy --locked -p gpui-kit-material-gallery -p gpui-kit-material-bench --all-targets --no-default-features --features gpui-kit-material-gallery/embedded-symbols,gpui-kit-material-gallery/frame-profiler,gpui-kit-material-bench/embedded-symbols -- -D warnings
          cargo test --locked -p gpui-kit-material-gallery --no-default-features --features embedded-symbols
      - name: Check the Gallery's profiler and instruction counters
        run: |
          cargo clippy --locked -p gpui-kit-material-gallery -p gpui-kit-material-bench --all-targets --features gpui-kit-material-gallery/frame-profiler,gpui-kit-material-gallery/instruction-bench -- -D warnings
          cargo test --locked -p gpui-kit-material-gallery --lib --features frame-profiler -- interactions::
      # Each alone: in a command naming several packages, features unify across them, which
      # is how a bench that needed the Gallery's test-support kept passing the steps above.
      - name: Build each benchmark as its documentation does
        run: |
          cargo check --locked --release -p gpui-kit-material-bench --bin component_bench
          cargo check --locked --release -p gpui-kit-material-gallery --bin gallery --features instruction-bench
      - name: The browser profiler's report
        run: node scripts/check-web-profile.mjs
      - name: The profiler's report rules
        run: python3 scripts/test_profile_gallery.py
      - name: Engine rules as a consumer builds them, and the lazy tab-stop index
        working-directory: gpui-kit-material/crates/consumer-check
        run: |
          cargo test --locked -p consumer-check -p gpui-pre --lib profiler
          cargo test --locked -p consumer-check -p gpui-fast --features gpui-fast --lib profiler
          cargo test --locked -p consumer-check -p gpui-pre --lib tab_stop
          cargo test --locked -p consumer-check -p gpui-fast --features gpui-fast --lib tab_stop
      # Builds the library beside upstream's gpui-fps against only the patches a
      # consumer needs, so library code cannot start to depend on a workspace-only patch.
      - name: Consumer patch set
        run: |
          cargo check --locked --manifest-path crates/consumer-check/Cargo.toml
          cargo check --locked --manifest-path crates/consumer-check/Cargo.toml --features gpui-fast
      # Clippy's -D warnings covers workspace members only. RUSTFLAGS also
      # reaches the vendored path crates we patch (registry crates stay
      # cap-linted); a separate target dir keeps the main cache valid.
      - name: Deny warnings in vendored engine crates
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        env:
          RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings
          CARGO_TARGET_DIR: target/deny-warnings
        run: cargo check --locked --workspace --all-targets
      - name: Vendored text regression tests
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          cargo test --locked -p gpui-pre-apple --test font_fallback
          cargo test --locked -p gpui-pre --lib text_system
          cargo test --locked -p gpui-kit-material -p gpui-fast --features gpui-kit-material/gpui-fast --lib
          cargo test --locked -p gpui-fast-apple --test font_fallback

  # What a consumer can select. Features read manifests and cfgs, not the platform, so
  # one OS is enough, plus the browser target for what the Web build compiles.
  features:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: gpui-kit-material
      # rust-toolchain.toml pins the exact compiler, components and targets.
      - name: Install the pinned toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install
          rustc --version
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: gpui-kit-material -> target
      - name: Linux libraries
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libwayland-dev libvulkan-dev libx11-xcb-dev libxcb1-dev libfontconfig-dev libfreetype-dev
      - name: Each feature combination
        run: scripts/check-features.sh
      - name: The same on the browser target
        run: scripts/check-features.sh --target wasm32-unknown-unknown

  # consumer-check reads the library and its patches from this checkout, so it says
  # nothing about what a downstream application gets from Git. This job builds the
  # README's quick start from the pushed commit, with a fresh resolve and no lockfile.
  git-consumer:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: macos-latest
            target: ""
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: ""
          - os: windows-latest
            target: ""
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: wasm32-unknown-unknown
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: gpui-kit-material
      # rust-toolchain.toml pins the exact compiler, components and targets.
      - name: Install the pinned toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install
          rustc --version
      - name: Linux libraries
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && matrix.target == ''
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libwayland-dev libvulkan-dev libx11-xcb-dev libxcb1-dev libfontconfig-dev libfreetype-dev
      - name: Build the quick start from Git
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
        run: |
          scripts/check-git-consumer.sh \
            --repo "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --rev "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/git-consumer" \
            ${TARGET:+--target "$TARGET"}

  # The packaged library built as crates.io would receive it, with no [patch], against Kit's
  # Git main standing in for its next release. It cannot pass until Kit has every Base API the
  # library calls (docs/RELEASING.md), so it reports without failing CI.
  release-readiness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: gpui-kit-material
      # rust-toolchain.toml pins the exact compiler, components and targets.
      - name: Install the pinned toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install
          rustc --version
      - name: Linux libraries
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libwayland-dev libvulkan-dev libx11-xcb-dev libxcb1-dev libfontconfig-dev libfreetype-dev
      - name: The package against Kit's main
        run: |
          kit=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit refs/heads/main | cut -f1)
          echo "Kit main: $kit"
          scripts/check-registry-consumer.sh --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/registry-consumer" --kit-git "$kit"

  # Packaging and dependency policy read manifests, not the platform, so one OS is enough.
  package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: gpui-kit-material
      # rust-toolchain.toml pins the exact compiler, components and targets.
      - name: Install the pinned toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install
          rustc --version
      - name: What each package ships
        run: scripts/check-package.sh
      - name: The site Worker's rules
        run: node --test deploy/site/worker.test.js
      # gpui-kit-material waits for a Kit release (docs/RELEASING.md; the release-readiness job).
      - name: Publish dry run of the crate without Git dependencies
        run: cargo publish --locked --dry-run -p gpui-kit-material-color
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny@0.20.2
      - name: Licenses, sources, advisories and bans
        run: cargo deny --locked check

  wasm:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: gpui-kit-material
      # rust-toolchain.toml pins the exact compiler, components and targets.
      - name: Install the pinned toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install
          rustc --version
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: gpui-kit-material -> target
      - name: Consumer patch set
        run: |
          cargo check --locked --manifest-path crates/consumer-check/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
          cargo check --locked --manifest-path crates/consumer-check/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features gpui-fast
      - name: Check the upstream WASM gallery
        run: cargo clippy --locked -p gpui-kit-material-gallery-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features -- -D warnings
      - name: Install the matching browser binding generator
        run: |
          version="$(awk '$0 == "name = \"wasm-bindgen\"" { getline; gsub(/version = |"/, ""); print; exit }' Cargo.lock)"
          test -n "$version"
          cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version "$version" --locked
      - name: Build upstream browser artifacts
        run: ./scripts/build-gallery-web.sh --upstream
      - name: Check the Fast WASM gallery
        run: cargo clippy --locked -p gpui-kit-material-gallery-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features gpui-fast -- -D warnings
      - name: Build Fast browser artifacts
        run: ./scripts/build-gallery-web.sh --fast

# Extraction from course2md

Where each shared course2md desktop primitive now lives. course2md has not
switched to the kit yet; this table is the guide for that change.

| course2md (`desktop/src`) | gpui-kit-material |
| --- | --- |
| `palettes.rs` | `color::palette` (serde behind the `serde` feature) |
| `theme.rs` tokens `ColorToken` / `CANVAS`… | `color::ColorRole::SURFACE_CONTAINER`… (canonical M3 roles; the old names remain as deprecated aliases. `ColorRole` avoids GPUI's accessibility `Role`) |
| `theme::palette_colors` | `color::Scheme::from_palette` |
| `theme::color`, `blend`, `apply_preference`, `system_dark` | `theme::color`, `theme::blend`, `theme::init_component_theme` + `theme::advance_component_theme` (with `ThemePreferences::resolve(system_dark(cx))`), `theme::system_dark` |
| `theme::apply_scale` | the `scale` argument of `theme::init_component_theme` / `theme::advance_component_theme`, which also keeps gpui-component's theme in sync |
| radii, `TILE_*`, `tile_corners`, `list_corners` | `tokens::shape` (`OuterCorners`) |
| `TEXT_*` | `tokens::typography` (+ `rem(px)`) |
| `CONTROL_HEIGHT`, `ICON_SLOT`, `SETTING_ITEM_INSET`, `COMPACT_WINDOW`, `title_bar_height` | `tokens::layout` (`ITEM_INSET`, `app_bar_height`) |
| `shadow_card`, `shadow_popover` | `tokens::elevation::level0`…`level5` |
| `motion.rs` springs, `enter`, `state_enter`, `page_enter`, `value`, `selection_value`, `disclosure` | `motion` |
| `motion::{spinner, icon_spinner, progress, linear_progress, indeterminate_progress}` | `components` (progress) |
| `choice_group::SingleChoiceGroup` | `components::ConnectedButtonGroup` |
| `TileScale`, `TileGroup`, `tile`, `list_tile`, `tile_info`, `tile_chevron`, `disclosure_chevron` | `components` (tile); `TileScale::button` returns a `RingedButton` |
| `ChoiceTile`, `choice_radio`, `Tint`, `tinted_icon` | `components` (choice) |
| `accessible_text`, `error_text`, `semantic_label`, `supporting_info`, `info_callout`, `page_heading`, `section_title`, `section_heading` | `components` (text) |
| `badge`, `outlined_badge` | `components::{status_chip, outlined_status_chip}` (the old names remain deprecated; `Badge` is now the M3 badge) |
| `chip` | `components` (chips) |
| `notice_banner`, `card_surface` | `components` (feedback) |
| `focus_scroll::{FocusRing, RevealFocus, contain_scroll}` | `components` (focus) |
| `window_controls` | `components::{CaptionButtons, Caption, CaptionLabels, title_bar_control}` |
| `icons.rs` (subset used by components) | `icons::{IconName, Icon, Assets}` |

## Stayed in course2md

- **Wrappers around gpui-component controls**: `control`, `primary_pill`,
  `tonal_pill`, `outline_pill`, `text_button`, `icon_button`, `danger_pill`,
  `text_input`, `search_field`, `confirm_dialog`, `preference_switch`,
  `SelectField`, `menu_style`, scrollbars. They rely on course2md's reviewed
  gpui-component patches (`MenuStyle`, `label_text_size`, switch geometry). The
  roadmap replaces them with kit components on Kit's Component and Base layers.
- **Product-specific layout**: `hero_top`, `task_dialog_top`, image viewer
  metrics, `cover_frame`, `nav_destination*`, `detail_row`, `transfer_status`.
- **Localization**: `tr!` strings now arrive as parameters.

[package]
name = "gpui-kit-material-color"
description = "Material 3 color roles, built-in palettes and scheme derivation for gpui-kit-material, without a GPUI dependency"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
# MIT (LICENSE), plus the Apache-2.0 port of material-color-utilities in src/dynamic
# (licenses/material-color-utilities.txt) and the palette notices in licenses/.
license = "MIT AND Apache-2.0"
repository.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true
keywords = ["material", "color", "theme", "gpui"]
categories = ["gui"]
readme = "README.md"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true

[features]
default = ["serde", "dynamic"]
serde = ["dep:serde"]
# `dynamic`: HCT, tonal palettes and seed schemes, ported from material-color-utilities.
# Without it the HCT core still compiles, privately, for the tint families' harmonized hues.
dynamic = []

[dependencies]
serde = { workspace = true, optional = true }

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json.workspace = true

[[test]]
name = "dynamic_hct"
required-features = ["dynamic"]

[[test]]
name = "dynamic_palettes"
required-features = ["dynamic"]

[[test]]
name = "dynamic_schemes"
required-features = ["dynamic"]

[[test]]
name = "dynamic_timing"
required-features = ["dynamic"]

[package]
name = "gpui-kit-material-gallery-web"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
# Links crates/gallery, which bundles IBM Plex Sans and Roboto under OFL-1.1, and serves
# Material Symbols under Apache-2.0.
license = "MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND OFL-1.1"
publish = false

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[features]
default = ["gpui-fast"]
gpui-fast = ["gpui-kit/gpui-fast", "gpui-kit-material/gpui-fast", "gpui-kit-material-gallery/gpui-fast"]

[target.'cfg(target_family = "wasm")'.dependencies]
gpui-kit.workspace = true
gpui-kit-material = { path = "../material", default-features = false, features = ["serde"] }
gpui-kit-material-gallery = { path = "../gallery", default-features = false }
wasm-bindgen = "=0.2.129"
web-sys = { version = "=0.3.106", features = ["Window", "MediaQueryList", "MediaQueryListEvent", "EventTarget", "Location"] }

[package]
name = "gpui-kit-material-bench"
description = "Standalone frame benchmark for gpui-kit-material: component_bench"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
# Draws with the Gallery's Roboto (OFL-1.1, crates/gallery/fonts/roboto).
license = "MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND OFL-1.1"
repository.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true
publish = false

[features]
default = ["gpui-fast", "embedded-symbols"]
gpui-fast = ["gpui-kit/gpui-fast", "gpui-kit-material/gpui-fast"]
embedded-symbols = ["gpui-kit-material/embedded-symbols"]

[target.'cfg(not(target_family = "wasm"))'.dependencies]
anyhow.workspace = true
gpui-base.workspace = true
# The benches read `Window::layout_stats`, which is behind test-support. Selecting it here
# rather than relying on the Gallery's selection unifying with it is what lets
# `cargo build -p gpui-kit-material-bench` compile alone. It costs no per-frame work in a
# release build: selectors stay off without debug assertions, and the extra timers are off
# until `Window::reset_layout_stats`.
gpui-kit = { workspace = true, features = ["test-support"] }
gpui-kit-material = { path = "../material", default-features = false, features = ["full", "serde"] }
serde_json.workspace = true

[package]
name = "gpui-kit-material-gallery"
description = "The shared desktop and WASM Gallery of gpui-kit-material"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
# Bundles IBM Plex Sans and Roboto under OFL-1.1 (their licenses sit beside them in
# fonts/), and serves or embeds Material Symbols under Apache-2.0.
license = "MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND OFL-1.1"
repository.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true
publish = false

[[bin]]
name = "gallery"
path = "src/main.rs"

[features]
default = ["gpui-fast", "embedded-symbols"]
gpui-fast = ["gpui-kit/gpui-fast", "gpui-kit-material/gpui-fast"]
# The browser downloads the two styles it draws; see crates/gallery-web.
embedded-symbols = ["gpui-kit-material/embedded-symbols"]
# scripts/profile-gallery.py's per-frame report: `performance.rs`, `interactions.rs`.
frame-profiler = ["gpui-kit/profiler"]
# Per-frame instruction counts; see `src/instr_bench.rs`.
instruction-bench = ["gpui-fast"]

[dependencies]
gpui-base.workspace = true
gpui-kit.workspace = true
gpui-kit-material = { path = "../material", default-features = false, features = ["full", "serde"] }

[target.'cfg(not(target_family = "wasm"))'.dependencies]
anyhow.workspace = true
# `render_to_image`, which `--capture` draws with, is behind test-support.
gpui-kit = { workspace = true, features = ["test-support"] }
serde_json.workspace = true

[target.'cfg(target_family = "wasm")'.dependencies]
wasm-bindgen = "=0.2.129"
web-sys = { version = "=0.3.106", features = ["Window", "Location", "EventTarget"] }

[package]
name = "gpui-kit-material"
description = "Material 3 design tokens, motion and component adapters for Longbridge GPUI Kit"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
# MIT (LICENSE, src/motion/LICENSE-material), plus Apache-2.0 for the rules ported
# from androidx (src/components/LICENSE-androidx, src/shapes/LICENSE-androidx).
license = "MIT AND Apache-2.0"
repository.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true
readme = "README.md"
# What crates.io gets: the library, its tests and fixtures, and the license texts it names.
include = ["src/**/*", "tests/**/*", "LICENSE", "README.md"]
keywords = ["material", "material-design", "gpui", "ui", "desktop"]
categories = ["gui"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
targets = ["x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"]

[features]
default = ["full", "serde", "embedded-symbols", "gpui-fast"]
embedded-symbols = ["gpui-material-symbols/embed-assets"]
serde = ["gpui-kit-material-color/serde"]
gpui-fast = ["gpui-kit/gpui-fast"]

# Every group below. Backend, symbols and serde stay separate choices.
full = [
    "adaptive",
    "buttons",
    "containment",
    "dialogs",
    "dynamic-color",
    "feedback",
    "inputs",
    "loading",
    "menus",
    "navigation",
    "pickers",
    "progress",
    "selection",
    "shapes",
    "window-chrome",
]
# MaterialButton, IconButton, ButtonGroup, ConnectedButtonGroup, SplitButton, Fab, FabMenu.
buttons = ["menus", "progress"]
# LinearProgress, CircularProgress, Stepper.
progress = []
# LoadingIndicator, PullToRefresh.
loading = ["progress", "shapes"]
# Badge, Snackbar, MaterialTooltip, MaterialCard, drop targets, status chips and notices.
feedback = []
# Checkbox, radio, switch, chips, slider, tiles and choice tiles.
selection = []
# TextField, SearchField, SearchView.
inputs = []
# MaterialMenu, MenuPopup, MaterialContextMenu, and ExposedDropdown when `inputs` is on too.
menus = []
# DatePicker, TimePicker.
pickers = ["buttons", "dep:chrono", "inputs"]
# MaterialDialog, MaterialBottomSheet, MaterialSideSheet.
dialogs = []
# Avatar, MaterialCarousel, MaterialDivider, ListItem.
containment = ["selection"]
# NavigationBar, NavigationRail, NavigationDrawer, NavigationSuite, MaterialTabs, TopAppBar,
# BottomAppBar, Toolbar.
navigation = ["adaptive", "dialogs", "feedback"]
# Window size classes, PaneScaffold, FeedLayout.
adaptive = []
# TitleBar, CaptionButtons.
window-chrome = []
# MaterialShape and Morph.
shapes = []
# `color::dynamic`: HCT and seed schemes.
dynamic-color = ["gpui-kit-material-color/dynamic"]

[dependencies]
log = "0.4"
gpui-kit-material-color.workspace = true
gpui-kit.workspace = true
gpui-material-symbols = { version = "0.1", default-features = false, features = ["gpui-kit"] }
gpui-base.workspace = true
# Already in Cargo.lock through GPUI Base's calendar; the pickers share its date types.
chrono = { version = "0.4.38", default-features = false, features = ["clock"], optional = true }

[target.'cfg(target_family = "wasm")'.dependencies]
web-time = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
# Only the icon asset-source test uses anyhow.
anyhow.workspace = true

[target.'cfg(not(target_family = "wasm"))'.dev-dependencies]
serde_json.workspace = true
gpui-kit = { workspace = true, features = ["test-support"] }

[[test]]
name = "block_surface"
required-features = ["full"]

[[test]]
name = "compose_shapes"
required-features = ["shapes"]

[[test]]
name = "input_move_guard"
required-features = ["full"]

[[test]]
name = "kit_theme"
required-features = ["full"]

[[test]]
name = "tab_stops"
required-features = ["full"]

[[test]]
name = "wheel_guard"
required-features = ["full"]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Publish target/site (from scripts/build-site.sh) to material.mizore.blog with
# the Cloudflare CLI, then check the live URLs. Run by hand after `cf auth login`;
# no credentials live in this repository and CI does not deploy. Refuses a site not
# built from the current commit. --check stops after the checks, publishing nothing.
set -euo pipefail
check_only=false
case "${1:-}" in
  "") ;;
  --check) check_only=true ;;
  *) echo "Usage: $0 [--check]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

workspace_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$workspace_dir"
origin="https://material.mizore.blog"
target_dir="$(cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["target_directory"])')"
site_dir="$target_dir/site"
if [[ ! -f "$site_dir/index.html" || ! -f "$site_dir/gallery/index.html" || ! -f "$site_dir/api/index.html" ]]; then
  echo "Run ./scripts/build-site.sh first: $site_dir is incomplete." >&2
  exit 1
fi
# Cloudflare rejects a static asset over 25 MiB.
oversized="$(find "$site_dir" -type f -size +26214400c)"
if [[ -n "$oversized" ]]; then
  echo "Over the 25 MiB per-file limit:" >&2
  echo "$oversized" >&2
  exit 1
fi
# The CLI caches account details in .cloudflare/ under its working directory.
if [[ -n "$(find "$site_dir" -name .cloudflare -print -quit)" ]]; then
  echo "Refusing to publish a .cloudflare directory from $site_dir." >&2
  exit 1
fi
python3 scripts/site_stamp.py verify "$site_dir"
wasm_path="$(cd "$site_dir" && find gallery/wasm -name 'gallery.*.wasm')"
if [[ ! -f "$site_dir/$wasm_path.br" ]]; then
  echo "$wasm_path has no Brotli copy for the Worker to serve." >&2
  exit 1
fi
commit="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
if [[ "$check_only" == true ]]; then
  echo "$site_dir is the site of $commit and ready to deploy."
  exit 0
fi

(
  cd deploy/site
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error
  SITE_DIR="$site_dir" npx cf deploy --message "$commit"
)

status=0
for path in / /gallery/ /api/; do
  # A new hostname can take a few minutes to resolve and get its certificate.
  code="$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --retry 30 --retry-delay 10 --retry-all-errors "$origin$path" || true)"
  echo "$code $origin$path"
  [[ "$code" == 200 ]] || status=1
done
# The Worker's copy, not Cloudflare's recompression, reached the visitor.
encoding="$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -D - -H 'Accept-Encoding: br' "$origin/$wasm_path" | tr -d '\r' | awk 'tolower($1) == "content-encoding:" { print $2 }')"
echo "content-encoding: ${encoding:-none} $origin/$wasm_path"
[[ "$encoding" == br ]] || status=1
exit "$status"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Capture pinned reference circular button geometry, real pointer states, and content.

Usage: python3 scripts/capture-button-circular.py /path/to/material output.json
Captures actual CSS :active and selected/disabled states plus icon/text/loading. Requires git, bun, npx, agent-browser.
Uses original createButton and complete main.scss compiled with Sass 1.85.1; no reference source edits.
"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile

import reference_capture as capture
from reference_capture import REVISION


def main():
    parser = capture.parser(__doc__)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    source = args.source.resolve()
    # All imports of the actual button and progress must match the pinned revision.
    capture.require_reference(parser, source, "src", "Reference HEAD must be ",
                              "Reference src (including styles and progress) must be clean")
    sampler = capture.sampler(__file__)
    data = {"reference": REVISION, "tools": capture.tool_versions()}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="material-button-circular-") as directory:
        work = Path(directory)
        capture.bundle(work, "import createButton from " + capture.module(source / "src/components/button/button.ts") + ";\n"
                       "window.referenceCreateButton=createButton;\n")
        capture.compile_sass(source / "src/styles/main.scss", work / "buttons.css")
        data["stylesheet_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256((work / "buttons.css").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        (work / "index.html").write_text('<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><link rel="stylesheet" href="buttons.css"><script src="entry.js"></script><body></body>')
        with capture.serve(directory) as port:
            with capture.browser_session("material-button-circular-") as browser:
                evaluate = browser.evaluate
                browser("open", f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}")
                browser("set", "media", "light")
                evaluate(sampler)
                data["media"] = evaluate("({dark:matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches,reduced_motion:matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches})")
                data["ua"] = evaluate("navigator.userAgent")
                data["states"] = []
                for size in ("xs", "s", "m", "l", "xl"):
                    for shape in ("round", "square"):
                        config = {"size": size, "shape": shape}
                        browser("mouse", "move", "500", "400")
                        evaluate("mountCircular(" + json.dumps(config) + ")")
                        row = {**config, "default": evaluate("snapshotCircular()")}
                        browser("mouse", "move", "40", "35")
                        browser("mouse", "down", "left")
                        row["pressed"] = evaluate("snapshotCircular()")
                        browser("mouse", "up", "left")
                        evaluate("circularButton.disable()")
                        row["disabled"] = evaluate("snapshotCircular()")
                        browser("mouse", "move", "500", "400")
                        evaluate("mountCircular(" + json.dumps({**config, "toggle": True, "selected": True}) + ")")
                        row["selected"] = evaluate("snapshotCircular()")
                        browser("mouse", "move", "40", "35")
                        browser("mouse", "down", "left")
                        row["selected_pressed"] = evaluate("snapshotCircular()")
                        browser("mouse", "up", "left")
                        evaluate("circularButton.disable()")
                        row["selected_disabled"] = evaluate("snapshotCircular()")
                        for state in ("pressed", "selected_pressed"):
                            if not row[state]["active"]:
                                raise ValueError("Real pointer press did not activate " + str(config))
                        data["states"].append(row)
                browser("mouse", "move", "500", "400")
                data.update(evaluate("circularContentMatrix()"))
                heights = {"xs": 32, "s": 40, "m": 56, "l": 96, "xl": 136}
                selected_round = {"xs": 12, "s": 12, "m": 16, "l": 28, "xl": 28}
                pressed_round = {"xs": 8, "s": 8, "m": 12, "l": 16, "xl": 16}
                for row in data["states"]:
                    radius = "50%" if row["shape"] == "round" else "12px"
                    for state in ("default", "pressed", "disabled"):
                        if row[state]["css"]["radius"] != [radius] * 4:
                            raise ValueError("Circular resting/pressed radius changed")
                    selected_radius = selected_round[row["size"]] if row["shape"] == "round" else heights[row["size"]] / 2
                    selected_radius = f"{selected_radius:g}px"
                    for state in ("selected", "selected_disabled"):
                        if row[state]["css"]["radius"] != [selected_radius] * 4:
                            raise ValueError("Circular selected radius changed")
                    pressed_radius = pressed_round[row["size"]] if row["shape"] == "round" else 12
                    if row["selected_pressed"]["css"]["radius"] != [f"{pressed_radius}px"] * 4:
                        raise ValueError("Circular selected press radius changed")
                    for state in ("default", "pressed", "disabled", "selected", "selected_pressed", "selected_disabled"):
                        sample = row[state]
                        if sample["rect"]["width"] != 40 or sample["rect"]["height"] != heights[row["size"]]:
                            raise ValueError("Circular width/height cascade changed")
                for row in data["rows"]:
                    for state in ("before", "progress", "loading", "restored"):
                        sample = row[state]
                        if sample["rect"]["width"] != 40 or sample["rect"]["height"] != heights[row["size"]]:
                            raise ValueError("Circular content changed layout dimensions")
                        if sample["css"]["padding"] != ["0px"] * 4:
                            raise ValueError("Circular size padding changed")
                        if sample["text"] and sample["text"]["display"] != "none":
                            raise ValueError("Circular text must be hidden")
                    if not row["loading"]["disabled"] or row["loading"]["busy"] != "true":
                        raise ValueError("Loading semantics changed")
                if data["api"]["inline_width"]["rect"]["width"] != 40 or data["api"]["inline_important_width"]["rect"]["width"] != 200:
                    raise ValueError("Circular width importance changed")
            capture.write_json(args.output, data)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
